title: Tortière
ingredients: 6 slices bacon, cut into 1/4" (1 cm) pieces (6)
directions: In a frying pan, fry bacon over moderate heat until cooked but not crisp.
Add pork, beef and onion; cook until meat is lightly browned.
Add water and spices; reduce heat to simmer; cover pan and cook 45 minutes more.
Combine meat with mashed potatoes; cool slightly.
Meanwhile, line a 9-inch (20 cm) deep dish pie plate with pastry; fill with meat mixture.
Place top crust in position. Seal and flute edges, slash several times to vent.
Bake in hot oven 450° F (220° C) for 10-12 minutes. Reduce heat to 350° F (180° C) and bake 30 minutes longer.
Makes 5 or 6 servings.
notes: Excellent served with baked beans and pickled beets

title: Lamb Shish Kabobs
ingredients: 2 lb boneless lean lamb, cut into 1-inch pieces
directions: In shallow glass dish, combine oil, vinegar, lemon juice, McCormick Lemon & Pepper Seasoning and garlic. Stir in lamb. Cover and refrigerate several hours or overnight, turning once.

Cut zucchini and red pepper into 1-inch pieces. Thread on skewers alternately with lamb. Grill or broil 6-8 minutes on each side for medium doneness, brushing occasionally with marinade. Serve on bed of rice or couscous.
raw_text:
RECIPE CARD   McCormick   COLLECTION
Lamb Shish Kabobs
(serves 6)
1/3 cup  olive oil
3 tbsp   white wine vinegar
2 tbsp   lemon juice
1 tbsp   McCormick Lemon & Pepper Seasoning
1        clove garlic, minced
2 lb     boneless lean lamb, cut into 1-inch pieces
3        medium zucchini
1        large red pepper
In shallow glass dish, combine oil, vinegar, lemon juice, McCormick Lemon & Pepper Seasoning and garlic. Stir in lamb. Cover and refrigerate several hours or overnight, turning once.
Cut zucchini and red pepper into 1-inch pieces. Thread on skewers alternately with lamb. Grill or broil 6-8 minutes on each side for medium doneness, brushing occasionally with marinade. Serve on bed of rice or couscous.
